LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictBattlefield_Label: Goa'uld forces converge near the colony
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictBattlefield_Text0: Reconnaissance reports two Jaffa detachments entering from the map edge. Warriors serving {0} and {1} are moving toward opposing rally points before engaging. Their immediate objective is the rival force, not the colony. The colony may stay clear, intervene against either force or attack both.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictBattlefield_Text1: The open conflict between {0} and {1} has reached the colony's perimeter. Rival Jaffa units are arriving from the map edge and assembling at opposing positions. They are not launching an organized assault on the settlement, but any force that is challenged will retaliate against those responsible.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictBattlefield_Text2: Two Goa'uld columns belonging to {0} and {1} have entered the region. Each detachment is rallying before hostilities begin. The engagement can be ignored or exploited, but either force remains dangerous if attacked.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictBattlefield_Assault: The detachments of {0} and {1} have completed their rally and are launching the assault.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictBattlefield_BreaksO: {0}'s remaining Jaffa break contact after severe losses. {1}'s detachment holds the field while both forces begin withdrawing from the area.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictBattlefield_TimeLim: After prolonged fighting between {0} and {1}, both detachments disengage and begin withdrawing from the area.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictWorldSite_Text0: Long-range reconnaissance has located a developing battle between Jaffa detachments serving {0} and {1}. The engagement is far from the colony and can be ignored without consequence. A caravan may instead travel to the marked area and intervene once the two forces assemble.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictWorldSite_Text1: The open conflict between {0} and {1} has produced a temporary battlefield within caravan range. Neither domain is requesting assistance. The colony may avoid the area, observe the result or enter the fighting against either side.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictWorldSite_Text2: Intercepted Goa'uld traffic identifies two rival columns converging at the marked coordinates. Forces of {0} and {1} are expected to engage there. The marker will disappear when the battle moves on, with no penalty if the colony stays away.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictWorldSite_InspectPe: Signals from {0} and {1} are still converging on this region. Our observers estimate that the area will remain traceable for about {2}.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictWorldSite_InspectAc: Weapons fire and Goa'uld transmissions confirm that the forces of {0} and {1} are still fighting in the area.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictWorldSite_InspectRe: The weapons have fallen silent. Gather your people and leave the area when ready.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictWorldSite_AlreadyRe: The battlefield has already been resolved.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictWorldSite_RequiresC: A player caravan must be present on the battlefield site.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictWorldSite_Generatio: The battlefield map could not be initialized. The caravan remains on the world tile.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldOpenConflictWorldSite_ArrivalTe: The caravan has reached the battlefield between {0} and {1}. Both detachments are entering from the map edge and moving to their rally positions. They will attack one another after assembling. Any camp drawn into a clash with the caravan will treat those soldiers as another hostile force without abandoning the rival front.
